## Purpose

A standalone, human-readable walkthrough of the same field-management import
step `_targets.R` runs automatically (`mngmt_csv_outputs` / `crop_calendar`
targets). It calls the functions defined in
`2_preprocessing/R/functions_management.R` directly -- nothing here
reimplements pipeline logic. Open this file in RStudio and run chunks
individually (or Render the whole document) to inspect the crop calendar
derivation step by step.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gt)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_management.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Regenerate the crop calendar from raw management records

`run_management_import()` wraps the python script
`1_input_data/field_management/read_foulumngaard_mngmnt.py`, which reads every
`Handlinger_*.xlsx` file and derives two tables: `management_actions.csv`
(sowing/harvest/spraying/fertilising events) and `crop_calendar.csv` (inferred
crop occupancy per strip). Both are written to `4_outputs/data/field_management/`
(regenerable derived data, not raw input) -- if no `python` interpreter with
`pandas` is found, this falls back to the CSVs already committed there.

```{r regenerate-calendar}
csv_paths <- run_management_import(
  script_path = here("1_input_data", "field_management", "read_foulumngaard_mngmnt.py"),
  mngmt_dir   = here("1_input_data", "field_management"),
  out_dir     = here("4_outputs", "data", "field_management")
)
csv_paths
```

## Step 2: Load the crop calendar

```{r load-calendar}
crop_calendar <- load_crop_calendar(csv_paths[2])
crop_calendar |> glimpse()
```

```{r calendar-table}
crop_calendar |>
  arrange(strip, start_date) |>
  select(strip, crop_name, season_year, start_date, start_type, end_date, end_type) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(title = "Full crop occupancy calendar", subtitle = "Derived from Handlinger_YYYY.xlsx management files")
```

## Step 3: Crop rotation timeline (EDA)

The rotation each field strip follows across seasons -- the original
`SOIL_WATER.Rmd` had a version of this figure (restricted to strips with
suction cups), but it was never ported into this pipeline until now. Uses
`crop_colors` and `theme_study2()` from the validated design system (see
`3_analysis/R/plot_theme.R`).

```{r rotation-timeline}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
plot_crop_rotation_timeline(crop_calendar)
```

## Next step

`03_soil_water_import.qmd` uses this `crop_calendar` to determine which crop
was occupying each strip during the suction-cup monitoring window
(`lookup_strip_crop()`), the way `_targets.R`'s `strip_crop_lookup_tbl` target
does.
